page.overview:
What is Square Enix?

Square Enix publishes Final Fantasy, succeeding Square Soft after the Square–Enix merger and stewarding remakes, MMOs, and spin-offs.

Also known as: Square Enix Holdings, Square Soft, Squaresoft.
